config.program: v20 B4b - registered engineering measurement: additive next-token model on a constrained DSL (12 Aug 2026)

registration_notes.N90.1: Engineering MEASUREMENT milestone, not a claim audit. It measures the B4a programmatic memory as an additive next-token model on a generated constrained DSL; no novelty claim is made or licensed (M129 verdict: this is classic n-gram/PPM/cache-LM territory).
registration_notes.N90.2: Hypothesis registered before measurement: (a) the additive interpolated next-token model's test perplexity decreases as the window (the 'how far back' dial) grows; (b) footprint grows with window; (c) per-token operations grow slowly with window (integer lookups/adds, not multiply-accumulates).
registration_notes.N90.3: Corpus is DETERMINISTICALLY GENERATED, not downloaded: a small statement/expression DSL produced by a seeded generator, split by SEED (train/valid/test programs never share a seed), so the corpus is byte-reproducible with zero network dependency. No external text.
registration_notes.N90.4: Model is ADDITIVE in its construction: p(next|context) is a uniform mixture over orders k=1..K of add-alpha-smoothed exact-order counts (Jelinek-Mercer with uniform lambda) - each order is an independent count term summed in. Built from ProgrammaticMemory.exact_continuations.
registration_notes.N90.5: Sanity gate (kill switch): window=8 test perplexity must not exceed window=1 test perplexity by more than 10% (more memory must not hurt with proper smoothing); a fired switch is reported as a negative on the additive construction, not silently dropped.
registration_notes.N90.6: The small-transformer comparison is DISCLOSED as not run: training any transformer on this environment's compute GPU (display GPU, TDR risk) is out of scope. The additive model is reported against a uniform baseline and its own window sweep only; the transformer arm is recorded as not performed, not claimed.
registration_notes.N90.7: Cost accounting: footprint in stored-table bytes (ProgrammaticMemory.footprint_bytes); per-token operations counted as integer lookups + adds (the model is add-only, no multiply-accumulates); wall-clock is never a comparison currency.
registration_notes.N90.8: Smoke runs use _smoke_note + _smoke_skip_gates and MUST refuse the sealed output dir.
registration_notes.N90.9: This evidence is a dated snapshot; it records the exact generator seeds, grammar, and window ladder so a reader can repeat the measurement byte-for-byte.

disclosure: small-transformer comparison NOT run (compute GPU = display GPU, TDR risk); additive model reported vs uniform baseline and its own window sweep only (N90.6)
hypothesis: additive interpolated next-token test perplexity decreases with the window (how far back); footprint grows with window; per-token operations grow slowly
note: engineering measurement on a generated constrained DSL; no novelty claim (N90.1)
